newsitem.title: USA: US LPGs slightly lower to unchanged in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: US LPGs slightly lower to unchanged in quiet trade.

text.p: U.S. spot LPG prices were slightly lower to unchanged in a quiet market Tuesday that had several players on the sidelines awaiting industry stock data.
In the Gulf Coast trading hub of Mont Belvieu, Texas, normal butane remained largely steady at 48.75 cents to 49.25 cents, holding on to its 1.75 cent intraday slip.
Conway, Kansas, hub normal butane also remained at 45.00/45.25 cents in thin talk.
"There aren't many buyers out this afternoon," said one Houston trader, noting many players bought at high numbers in Monday's volatile market.
The market was driven up early Monday following an explosion at a natural gas liquids pipeline on Saturday, but has since begun to ease with news that distribution would not be severely impacted.
In quiet activity, Belvieu propane also remained 40.50/40.75 cents with a September parcel sold for 40.38 cents, traders said.
Conway material fell one cent to 38.75/39.00 cents, traders said, with a deal done at 39.00 cents.
Traders said the expected release of API industry data on Wednesday lent to quiet activity today.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859-1631
